$description: Input V2 Component Contract. Input and LineEdit share the public input family; visual values remain in the Recipe.

definitions.password: single-line protected text with password visibility toggle
definitions.search: single-line search input with search affordance
definitions.multiline: multi-line editable text without native clear action
definitions.dropdown-search: searchable input with a dropdown result surface
definitions.file-browser: editable resource text with browse action and clear action

pointerInteraction.meaning: default and hover describe the field surface before editing

focus.meaning: focused changes border presentation and preserves the caret

validation.meaning: error has priority over focused, hover and default

availability.meaning: disabled and loading lock interaction; readonly shares the disabled visual

mode.meaning: mode controls Slot qualification and editing behavior, not a second component family

compositionRules: Input and LineEdit are one public input family; Qt class choice is a platform implementation detail.
Mode, Appearance, State and Size are independent Registry axes; mode-specific Slot qualification is resolved by the Contract.
Placeholder uses the active State text color and does not create a dedicated placeholder-color Token.
Multiline uses the same input family and is expressed through mode; line count and height are runtime API values, not design axes.
Multiline does not expose a native clear action; external runtime code may clear its value through an explicit interface.
Password visibility toggling changes only password visibility and does not introduce another axis.
Resource-picker is an Input mode with browse action and may open a secondary resource browser overlay.
Loading preserves trailing actions, adds the spinner to their right, disables the actions and locks editing.
Focus Ring is never enabled; focused visual emphasis is expressed by the border Slot.
Error has higher visual priority than focused, hover and disabled-like presentation.

rules: multiline has no native clear action
password-toggle is valid only for password mode
search-icon is valid only for search and dropdown-search mode
browse-action is valid only for file-browser mode
loading keeps qualified actions and places spinner to their right

recipeOwns: container, content, placeholder, border, focus-ring, action and spinner visual references
shared size, padding and spacing bindings
sparse mode, appearance and state visual overrides
runtimeOwns: text editing, caret and IME behavior
resource browser opening and returned value
multiline height, line count and external clear
contractDoesNotOwn: label, help text or validation message layout
